title: Option E ($c_\lambda$ Kashiwara crystal weight) and the $T = {}^3\mathrm{He}$ isospin invariance
html:
Remark. Option E (c_\lambda Kashiwara crystal weight) and the T = {}^3\mathrm{He} isospin invariance

Remark (Option E isospin test). The Option E Kashiwara crystal weight c_\lambda(q) evaluates the principal q-specialisation of the Schur polynomial. We apply it to test whether the canonical \bowtie_K-coupled words preserve the structural isospin invariance.

The mirror isobars ^3\mathrm{H} and ^3\mathrm{He} fail the invariance test under Option E. The weight factor c_\lambda heavily breaks the transpose-partition symmetry required by the Hopf antipode. Only symmetric weights can preserve the structural isospin equality. We require a properly symmetrised variant to correct the non-Markov-trace deviation.
